title: message_flows
description: Memory block written by Agent 4.4 (Email / WhatsApp). The complete, ready-to-deploy lifecycle/nurture sequences — email drips (Resend) and WhatsApp flows (Twilio WhatsApp Business API) — produced from the approved audience_segments and content_calendar. Each flow is a series of timed, channel-specific messages with ES-MX (or client primary language) client-facing copy, trigger/enrollment logic, exit conditions, and the funnel stage it serves. Read by Layer 5 (5.3 Lead Capture + Nurture executes the flows) and Layer 6 (6.1 Performance Analytics attributes opens/clicks/replies). Human gate: required on first deployment of each flow (first-deploy tier) — defaults to pending_review. | Depends on: audience_segments (1.2), content_calendar (L3), client_profile (DEL-17). | First authored: 2026-05-29.

message_id.description: Stable id, unique within the flow. Format: msg-{slug}.

channel.description: Delivery channel. email = Resend; whatsapp = Twilio WhatsApp Business API.

step.description: 1-based ordinal position of this message within its flow.

amount.description: Wait before sending this message. 0 = send immediately on the reference event.

from.description: Reference event the delay is measured from.

send_window.description: Optional local send window in client primary timezone, e.g. '09:00-20:00 America/Mexico_City'. WhatsApp messages must respect local quiet hours.

subject.description: Email subject line in ES-MX (or client primary language). Required for email; null for WhatsApp.

preheader.description: Email preview text in ES-MX. Optional; email only.

body.description: Client-facing message copy in ES-MX (or client primary language). Personalization tokens use {{first_name}} / {{company}} style. WhatsApp bodies stay short and may reference an approved template name.

whatsapp_template.description: Required when channel=whatsapp and the message is sent outside the 24h customer-service window: a pre-approved WhatsApp template reference (Twilio/Meta). Null for free-form replies inside the session window.

cta.description: Primary call to action for this message.

personalization_tokens.description: Merge tokens used in subject/body, e.g. ['{{first_name}}','{{institution}}'].

rationale.description: One short EN sentence (operator-facing) tying this message to its segment/funnel objective.

channel.description: Dominant channel. 'multichannel' = the flow mixes email and WhatsApp steps.

target_segment_id.description: audience_segments segment_id this flow nurtures; null if it spans all segments.

objective.description: What this flow is meant to achieve (EN, operator-facing).

event.description: Enrollment event that starts the flow.

source.description: Where the trigger fires from, e.g. 'lead_register (5.3)' / 'HubSpot workflow'.

exit_conditions.description: Conditions that remove a contact from the flow, e.g. 'replied', 'booked_demo', 'unsubscribed', 'goal_met'.

goal.description: The conversion event that marks the flow successful (used by Layer 6 attribution).

client_id.description: Client this message-flow set belongs to. Lowercase-hyphenated. Example: acme-co.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this message_flows block was generated.

gate_status.description: Human gate status. Agent 4.4 is first-deploy gated: a flow that has never been deployed defaults to pending_review; already-approved flows being regenerated may carry 'approved'. Must be 'approved' before Layer 5 (5.3) executes the flow.

lifecycle_stage.description: Carried from client_profile; affects messaging maturity and volume assumptions.

cycle_month.description: Marketing cycle this flow set was authored for, YYYY-MM. Null when evergreen.

markets.description: Target markets these flows serve, ordered by priority (MX/CO/DR/PR).

primary_language.description: Language of the client-facing copy. Default 'es-MX'.

compliance.description: Deliverability + consent guardrails the operator must confirm before first deploy.

email_unsubscribe_present.description: Every email flow includes a working unsubscribe link.

whatsapp_opt_in_required.description: WhatsApp marketing requires prior opt-in; true unless contact opted in.

quiet_hours_respected.description: No sends outside local quiet hours / send windows.

flows.description: Lifecycle/nurture flows. May be empty only when gate_status is 'blocked'.

messages_by_channel.description: Count of messages per channel, e.g. {"email": 5, "whatsapp": 3}.

flows_by_funnel_stage.description: Count of flows per funnel stage.

first_deploy_flow_ids.description: flow_ids that have never been deployed and therefore drive the first-deploy human gate.

planning_notes.description: EN — assumptions, gaps, coherence flags, blocked reasons, deliverability cautions.
